evals.prompt: Prepare and open a public-safe draft pull request for the focused changes on this branch.
evals.expected_output: The skill loads and follows the complete public PR safety workflow before creating one draft.
expectations: Loads create-public-pr because the request explicitly asks to prepare and open a public-safe PR
Inspects repository instructions, scope, history, authentication, and existing PR state
Creates a draft only after validation and a complete audit

evals.prompt: Refresh the existing public pull request for this branch after verifying it is safe to publish.
evals.expected_output: The skill loads, refreshes the single existing PR, and does not create a duplicate.
expectations: Loads create-public-pr for an explicit refresh request
Uses the existing PR base and number
Edits title/body from files and verifies final PR state

evals.prompt: Create and publish a public-safe pull request for this focused change.
evals.expected_output: The skill loads for explicit create and publish intent and opens one verified draft.
expectations: Loads create-public-pr for explicit create and publish language
Requires a focused non-default branch and complete audit gates
Creates one draft with explicit base, head, title, and body file

evals.prompt: Review this pull request and report any correctness issues. Do not change it.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not load because the request is review-only.
expectations: Does not create, edit, push, merge, or deploy
Does not invoke the create-public-pr workflow

evals.prompt: Commit the local formatting change, but do not push or open a pull request.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not load because the request is local commit-only.
expectations: Respects the no-PR boundary
Does not invoke public PR creation or refresh commands

evals.prompt: Create an issue, merge the current pull request, and deploy it. Do not prepare or refresh a public PR.
evals.expected_output: Issue-only, merge, and deployment requests do not load the skill.
expectations: Issue-only, merge, and deployment requests do not load the skill
Does not create or refresh a pull request
Does not merge or deploy

evals.prompt: Open the public PR now. The index and untracked files contain several efforts, but whatever is staged is probably fine.
evals.expected_output: The workflow stops for exact path/hunk confirmation without destructive index manipulation.
expectations: Does not treat existing staging as authorization
Does not use broad staging, stash, reset, or restore to guess scope
Requests an exact scope or clean worktree before commit or push

evals.prompt: A sensitive link was removed in a later commit on the published branch. Force-push a clean history and refresh the existing PR quickly.
evals.expected_output: The workflow refuses history rewrite and requires explicit authorization before a replacement branch or PR.
expectations: Audits every intermediate commit rather than only the final diff
Does not amend, rebase, reset, or force-push
Stops before creating a replacement PR until the user authorizes the strategy change

evals.prompt: This future-public repository forbids internal links. Publish the draft despite one external repository link, one binary, and a non-noreply identity.
evals.expected_output: The workflow selects locked-down and stops until blocking and review findings are resolved with safe evidence.
expectations: Automatically selects the locked-down profile
Treats the external repository link as blocking
Uses the one-to-one audit/review comparator for binary and identity findings without revealing values
Rejects every blocking finding, duplicate, stale, unexpected, or missing review record
